name: is_efx_goods_permute_of_utility_le
lines: u : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ
hu : ∀ (i : Fin n) (g : Fin m), 0 ≤ u i g
hp : ∀ (i : Fin n), additive_valuation (u i) (bundle_of σ i) ≤ additive_valuation (u i) (bundle_of σ (p i))
⊢ is_efx_goods u fun g => (Equiv.symm p) (σ g)
hg : g ∈ bundle_of (fun g => (Equiv.symm p) (σ g)) j
⊢ additive_valuation (u i) ((bundle_of (fun g => (Equiv.symm p) (σ g)) j).erase g) ≤
additive_valuation (u i) (bundle_of (fun g => (Equiv.symm p) (σ g)) i)
⊢ additive_valuation (u i) ((bundle_of σ (p j)).erase g) ≤ additive_valuation (u i) (bundle_of σ (p i))

steps.tactic: intro i j hij g hg
exact (is_efx_goods_all_pairs u hu σ hσ i (p j) g hg).trans (hp i)
